subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

After years of rivalry, the two families decided to __bury the hatchet.__

options.text: To end a quarrel by never talking to each other
To end a quarrel and become friendly

solution:
The correct answer is: **To end a quarrel and become friendly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"bury the hatchet"** means to end a conflict or quarrel and become friendly again. (झगड़ा समाप्त कर दोस्त बन जाना)

 
 
• **Example:** After years of disagreement, the two neighbors decided to bury the hatchet and work together for the community..
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**
